H01.description: Header changelog entries for grader 1.2.12/1.2.13 describing the narrowed collision removal.

H02.description: Adds imports (configparser, fnmatch, shlex, tomllib) needed by the new import-name collision logic.

H03.description: Grader version bump accompanying the collision-removal fix.

H04.description: remove_colliding deletes any agent-added .py whose bare basename matches a hidden/fixture test-dir .py (including helpers and modules inside packages, e.g. src/pkg/helpers.py), so correct solutions lose files and fail, while it misses real pytest import-name collisions in packages, ignores files inside directory overlays and the task's python_files setting.

H05.description: Records the new collision_rule in grade.json as telemetry of the fixed removal.

H06.description: Comment documenting the token exposure and the new API-key copy rule.

H07.description: The auth.json copy placed in the agent-readable per-run HOME keeps a long-lived OPENAI_API_KEY verbatim, exposing the operator's API key to the agent under evaluation.

H08.description: Header documentation of the revised pre-flight 6 horizon and API-key mode.

H09.description: Documents new codex_preflight fields in MANIFEST.json.

H12.description: Reads the new horizon override knob and initialises the pre-flight record variable used by the fixed pre-flight.

H14.description: On --resume the codex pre-flight counts every plan entry (including already-rowed trials) toward the token horizon, so a resume whose remaining trials fit the token's lifetime is wrongly refused.

H15.description: Adds auth_mode/trials_counted/horizon_source fields and a note slot to the pre-flight record for the fixed check.

H16.description: The required horizon 2 x sum(watchdog)/concurrency can be shorter than a single trial's own watchdog, so a token that expires mid-trial passes the pre-flight (and an API-key-mode auth.json without tokens.access_token is wrongly refused).

H17.description: Updates the refusal message for the new horizon formula, prints the API-key note and keeps the record in a variable instead of a scratch file.

H18.description: Passes the pre-flight record to jq from a variable instead of a $WORK file.

H19.description: Reads the pre-flight record from the variable instead of the slurped file.

H20.description: Passes the latest invocation's pre-flight record into STATUS.json so resume horizons are recorded.

H22.description: Version assertion update and new collision-removal tests.

H23.description: Adds a test for the API-key copy rule.

H26.description: Adds assertions and comment for the new horizon.

H29.description: Adds pre-flight tests for API-key mode, resume scope, override, lower bound and STATUS record.

I01.description: KF-048 refresh-token consumption was fixed by the placeholder copy already present at head; the entry records the earlier history.

I02.description: Contamination-scan false positives are fixed in other grader versions or concern later 1.3.x rules; the 1.2.11 row is an accepted heuristic limit with no grader change.

I03.description: Answer-key mount exposure is a harness design issue not shown in the head code of this change.

I04.description: Refusal fallback is designed behaviour, not a defect.

I05.description: Fixes the later 1.3.0 oracle detector and class 7 exemption, introduced after this change.

I06.description: Fixes edges of the later r1a oracle-detector code.

I07.description: Fixes later cycle-131 class 7 and oracle-detector code.

I08.description: eval_only handling was added in cycle-131, after this change.

I09.description: oracle_open toggle type check concerns later cycle-131 code.

I10.description: Fixes the later 1.3.0 oracle detector's handling of error-marked results and the sandbox mount.
